findings.place: Upper diagram, lower-middle Sigma after the unlabelled arrow: index and three-position decoration
findings.ink: The small index has a short rising left entry, a near-upright descending stroke, and a broad horizontal basal foot. This matches the serifed 1 of the upper Sigma_1 within the same existing crop, while the nearby 2 in Sigma_{2n} has a curved top and a descending return to the left. Thus the new audit correction is C-only: change index 2 to literal 1, agreeing with H. Independently, the node visibly has three separated decoration positions: an upper-left star, a lower-left star, and a right-hand dot. C already gives all three; H explicitly supplies only ast and dot. That retained H-only decoration discrepancy remains part of this same complete-node finding. No mathematical repair determines either reading.

notes: The lower-middle index of the upper diagram is changed from 2 to 1 on the visible strokes alone. H already reads 1 at this location. The main reader independently inspected the existing upper-nodes crop and confirmed the rising entry, upright and basal foot. No mathematical repair is used to choose the digit.

A01 merges into first-reading row D25 and therefore returns the complete decorated-node readings. The combined place differs from C in its index (2 instead of visible 1), and from H in its decoration (H gives only ast and dot rather than two left stars and a right dot). The new index correction is C-only; the H-only decoration discrepancy is retained without adding a new row.

The existing eight doubts remain: the compressed diviser/division ending; the cancelled par le fragment; the filled right decoration of the upper diagram lower-left node; the a/alpha subscript of the barred Sigma; the crossed group in the left note; donc/dont; the fourth decoration of the enclosed left node; and the extra small dot of the initial key. The four separate positions of the enclosed left-node decoration are visible, while the lower-right sign remains overfilled.

The final tout remains live. In the existing final crop its long upper stroke joins the two t stems, with low intervening letters; there is no independent cancellation stroke. The ending remains de la ramification sous les arêtes, without a final stop.

The definition key leaders, the two local deletions in the left note, the curved guide into the regrouping, and the plain lower-right connection in the enclosed diagram remain represented. No new contour, arrowhead or insertion was found in the independent reading.

hand_log.habit: A handwritten 1 can have a short rising left entry and a broad basal foot. The lower-middle index in the upper diagram matches the upper Sigma_1 in the same crop; the neighbouring 2 in Sigma_{2n} has a curved top and leftward descending return.
hand_log.universality: Local comparison of the specified indices on this leaf; not a universal rule for every handwritten 1 or 2.
misread_places: C and the pre-audit consolidated text: upper diagram, lower-middle Sigma index read as 2 instead of the visible 1. H already has 1.

coverage: Personally inspected the original once and both native overlapping halves once each, line by line, before current mark decisions and remaining-doubt descriptions. Compared all words, title and marginal text, every Sigma and D index, plus sign, star/dot position, relation, arrow, leader, insertion and deletion against the consolidated draft and the supplied C/H text. Checked all 46 inventory elements. Reused seven existing crops once each for the unresolved definition marks and caption, upper cancelled fragment, upper-node filled decoration and newly noticed index, right parenthetical index, left-note deletion and ending, four-position enclosed decoration, and the concrete final-tout stroke question. All eight final doubts are returned. No new crop, OCR, external research, TeX compilation or mathematical proof/check was performed.
